name: University of Salzburg
summary: Salzburg's public university, with 30+ bachelor's from AI to Philosophy, Politics and Economics; the university says all are taught in German.

ib.text: Austria accepts the IB Diploma without an equivalence check (ministry). PLUS needs German B2 (certificate or school-leaving certificate); with A2 you can apply and take the VPLUS course first.

notes: Artificial Intelligence and Philosophy, Politics and Economics are bachelor's here too, but, like the rest, they are taught in German.

sources.title: University of Salzburg — Bachelor's degree programmes ("The language of instruction for all bachelor's degree programmes is German.")
